elements.label: Duo owl plush mascot hopping behind the chessboard

pattern.description: The out-of-focus Duo plush hops up behind the white pieces, tilting slightly mid-air, and drops back to its starting spot within roughly a third of a second, with heavy motion blur; the foreground pieces stay put.
pattern.why_premium: A quick, physical character hop puts brand personality into a product beat: the mascot reacts like a living opponent, and the shallow focus plus real motion blur make the tabletop scene feel tactile and handmade instead of flat CG.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.timeline().to(mascot, {y: -90, rotation: -4, duration: 0.17, ease: 'power2.out'}).to(mascot, {y: 0, rotation: 0, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.in'}).to(mascot, {scaleY: 0.96, scaleX: 1.03, duration: 0.06, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: 'sine.inOut', transformOrigin: '50% 100%'}); add motion blur via a short filter: 'blur(3px)' at peak velocity.
build_hint.remotion: const hop = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, frame / 11)); translateY = -90 * hop; rotate = -4 * hop; on landing apply a squash with spring({frame: frame - 11, fps, config: {damping: 12, stiffness: 300}}) mapped to scaleY 0.96->1.

notes: facts.json reports camera.move = tilt_down, but the foreground chess pieces look stationary across the filmstrip; the motion appears to be the mascot hopping (live-action/stop-motion plush), so the tilt verdict is probably driven by the large moving mascot. Worth a human check. Only one full-frame candidate box (b01) exists. No SFX candidates.
